county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The guide was missing from the first aid kit.

top_violation_types.title: Meal preparation, except when 12 or fewer children are in care (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection a caregiver was observed preparing meals in the kitchen well supervising children.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §746.2907(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Awaken children were not given an alternative activity during naptime.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infant pack n plays had an added soft mattress. The added mattress did not come with the pack n plays.     Note: This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2805(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. Per interviews conducted it was determined staff have put young children in cribs as a method of discipline.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.
